cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(serialization_consumers LANGUAGES CXX)
if(WRAP_INSTALLED)
  find_package(gtwrap CONFIG REQUIRED)
else()
  list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${WRAP_ROOT}/cmake")
  include(PybindWrap)
  add_subdirectory("${WRAP_ROOT}/pybind11" pybind11)
endif()
find_package(Boost REQUIRED COMPONENTS serialization)
add_library(example_types INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(example_types INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(example_types INTERFACE Boost::headers)
if(WIN32)
  target_compile_definitions(example_types INTERFACE BOOST_ALL_NO_LIB)
  if(NOT Boost_USE_STATIC_LIBS)
    target_compile_definitions(example_types INTERFACE BOOST_SERIALIZATION_DYN_LINK)
  endif()
endif()
set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION OFF)
pybind_add_serialization_library(registry
  INTERFACES types.i consumer_a.i consumer_b.i
  HEADERS types.h LINK_LIBRARIES example_types)
foreach(consumer consumer_a consumer_b)
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${consumer}/preamble"
                      "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${consumer}/specializations")
  file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${consumer}/preamble/${consumer}.h" "")
  file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${consumer}/specializations/${consumer}.h" "")
  pybind_wrap(${consumer} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${consumer}.i"
    "${consumer}.cpp" ${consumer} "example" ""
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/module.tpl" "example_types" "" ON
    SERIALIZATION_LIBRARY registry)
endforeach()
add_executable(legacy legacy.cpp)
target_link_libraries(legacy PRIVATE example_types Boost::serialization)
add_library(unrelated SHARED unrelated.cpp)
target_link_libraries(unrelated PRIVATE example_types Boost::serialization)
target_compile_features(unrelated PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
foreach(target registry consumer_a consumer_b unrelated)
  set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
    VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON)
  if(APPLE)
    target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE LINKER:-dead_strip)
    set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "@loader_path")
  elseif(UNIX)
    target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE LINKER:--gc-sections LINKER:--as-needed)
    set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN")
  endif()
endforeach()
install(TARGETS registry consumer_a consumer_b unrelated legacy
  LIBRARY DESTINATION runtime RUNTIME DESTINATION runtime)
# All independent executables/modules use the same selected Boost runtime.
# Copy a shared Boost beside them to test a relocatable package layout.
if(NOT Boost_USE_STATIC_LIBS)
  install(FILES "$<TARGET_FILE:Boost::serialization>" DESTINATION runtime)
  if(UNIX)
    install(FILES "$<TARGET_SONAME_FILE:Boost::serialization>" DESTINATION runtime)
    set_target_properties(legacy PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN")
    if(APPLE)
      set_target_properties(legacy PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "@loader_path")
    endif()
  endif()
endif()
